---
title: "Project Planning Document"
---

**Due date**: March 10  
**Maximum length**: ~4-5 pages

## Overview

The project planning document is a basic shell/outline of an empirical quantitative research paper.

## Three Big Questions

The planning document should focus around three big questions:

### 1. Why are you planning to do this analysis?

Make sure to introduce any background information about the topic, the community, your business, or anything else that will be required to properly contextualize your study.

### 2. How will you get the data to analyze?

Describe the data sources you will collect and how they will be collected.

### 3. How will you analyze the data?

Describe the visualizations, tables, or statistical tests that you will produce.

## Submission

Submit your planning document via Brightspace.

## Resources

- See the [planning document guide](https://wiki.communitydata.science/CommunityData:Planning_document) for a helpful approach.
